desc:
Synopsis
The universe is vast and produces countless types of lifeforms, which form all races and all spirits. Although they are of different races and have different beliefs, they all share the same desire to attain the Way. All the races and all the spirits are just being bred by these masters. These masters, harvesting those who have attained the Way, harvesting the spiritual splendour of each world, destroying one world after another. Successive generations of attainers were unwilling to be harvested and constantly resisted, but they failed every time. Until ...... the protagonist Ye Yu appeared, he peeled back one era after another, peeling back one secret after another. As he unfolds the epic scroll, he grows up in this magnificent world, experiencing love and friendship, cleansing his dusty Taoist heart, and finally facing off against the master who harvests all the races and spirits.
